correctness.rationale: For a nonzero integer combination of the first d shifted P-values, the first nonzero moment of the shift coefficients has order s<d by Vandermonde invertibility. Its contribution in degree d-s is irrational and the lower polynomial coefficients can only contribute at lower degree. Weyl's criterion therefore gives Haar distribution on the d-torus modulo m. Conditioning on a prefix of d specified residue letters amounts to restricting to one unit box; the fractional parts there are independent uniform coordinates in the limiting law. The d-th finite difference gives the last letter as sum_i w_i A_i plus the correction floor(theta+sum_i w_i x_i) mod m. The total magnitude of its negative weights is 2^(d-1)-1 (the endpoint coefficient +1 was removed from the d-th difference); the positive magnitude is 2^(d-1). Reflecting negative coordinates now gives the sum of independent uniforms of lengths v_i, shifted by -s. Inclusion-exclusion on the positive simplex intersected with their box gives H_d, with the divisor d! times the product of v_i. The sum has positive mass in every nonempty open subinterval of (0,2^d-1). Irrationality gives theta=q+t with 0<t<1, so the deterministic fractional coordinates cannot produce corrections outside q-s through q+2^(d-1), even at a unit-box boundary. Each listed integer is realized on a set of positive volume, and the floor discontinuities are contained in finitely many hyperplanes of measure zero. This justifies the frequency formula and distinguishes actual impossibility from merely frequency zero. Reduction of the consecutive correction interval modulo m gives exactly min(m,2^d) extensions per prefix. The argument handles negative leading coefficients and d=1 unchanged, and shifting theta by m leaves the formula invariant. The uploaded check.py and VERIFICATION.md were inspected, not executed. Samples use exact integer floors for the chosen polynomials but the convolution and empirical probability comparisons are finite decimal/numerical diagnostics, not an exact all-parameter enumeration.

evidence: The indexed joint-gcd work proves Weyl joint equidistribution for up to d shifted monomials, including on arithmetic progressions. For d+1 consecutive translates it bounds the error in the integer-floor finite difference by 2^d and chooses a prime and leading phase to forbid one simultaneous divisibility pattern. This is real overlap in the subcritical proof and in the obstruction mechanism.
A general bracket-word frequency theorem supplies no information on which frequencies are positive. The binary quadratic law implies the frozen d=2,m=2 case as noted above.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The gcd argument at d+1 does not determine the exact range for every prefix and every m, does not show positivity throughout the permitted range, and does not calculate the volume of each slice. Optimizing the two signed ends, accounting for their nonintegral phase, and evaluating the slices are additional steps beyond its bounded-error obstruction.

evidence: Resultary 3b15bfec2e92 gives three-way fair independence and an exact four-bit law for the half-circle coding of S_lambda(x,y)=(x+lambda,y+x). For quadratic P, take y=P(0)/2, x=(P(1)-P(0))/2 and lambda equal to its leading coefficient, all modulo one as appropriate. Then the second coordinate is P(n)/2 mod 1, and its half-circle sign recodes the floor modulo two. The irrational skew shift is uniquely ergodic; coding boundaries have zero Haar measure. This is actual special-case coverage of the uniform length-three law, not merely a similar observable.

value.rationale: The first length beyond the rank-guaranteed equidistribution window is a natural place to ask which words can occur. The exact modulus threshold distinguishes full support from forbidden words and the volume formula distinguishes possible but very rare words from impossible ones. The finite-difference dependence is resolved quantitatively for every phase and all lower coefficients, rather than merely observing that independence of the continuous shifted coordinates fails.
